name: Resonant Brane Splatting
definition: A differentiable rendering primitive defined by a feature vector that predicts geometric anchoring, footprint/opacity, and internal mode colors, used for arbitrary-scale super-resolution (ASR).
summary: Resonant Brane Splatting is a super-resolution framework using expressive Brane primitives with internal Gaussian-Hermite modes to model spatially varying colors, unlike methods that keep color constant.
